operation.label: Invulnerability countdown
operation.note: The game may update a live countdown between write and readback; exact equality was not observed.

timer_only_aid.purpose: Visual reachability aid; not unassisted gameplay or performance evidence

performance.telemetry: Sequential one-Hz observations, not atomic with video frames; guest cadence differs from recorded video frame rate

video.capture: Owned game HWND Windows gfxcapture, NVENC H264, variable presentation timestamps
video.editing: Single continuous stream-copy excerpt. No retiming, interpolation, upscaling, re-encoding or internal cuts.

limitations: Draw receipts establish source admission; video/stills separately establish observed appearance, not every room or all city coverage.
No firing means enemy hit-flash and destruction acceptance is incomplete.
The full recording remains below sustained60 and has audio starvation increments; the facade bracket is a scoped result.
Static room/reflection artwork does not establish dynamic reflection or parallax.
Unseen phases, known art defects, full native progression, latest-menu acceptance, versioned installation and full-stage audio/pacing remain open.
